Pick a model in Models & settings to start asking.
Choose the model used in agent mode (must support vision when not using dual models).
How the agent reads the screen on every step. Pick one — either way the result goes to the \"Agent model\" above, which decides the next action.

Recognises on-screen text and coordinates on the phone itself and sends only that text to the agent model — no screenshot is uploaded. Works with any model, including text-only ones. Offline, free, cheapest and fastest. Reads text only; icon-only buttons are identified from accessibility controls instead.
Sends the screenshot to a cloud model, which can read icons, layout and visual detail. Slower and more expensive than local OCR.
The screenshot goes straight to the \"Agent model\" above, which looks and decides in one step. Most accurate, but the agent model must support vision or the request will fail.
The \"vision model\" describes the screenshot first, then the agent model reasons and acts from that description — so the agent model can be text-only. Costs an extra cloud call per step.
⚠️ No vision model selected, so dual-model pairing can\'t take effect — the screenshot is sent straight to the agent model instead. Choose a vision-capable model below.
Using the system recogniser (tap to use your own service)
Point this at any speech-to-text service compatible with OpenAI /v1/audio/transcriptions. Used by the voice assistant and the input-box mic. Leave blank to use the system recogniser.
Note: wake-word detection never uses this service. It always runs on the bundled offline model, since it listens continuously and must not upload audio.
Using the system engine (tap to use your own service)
Point this at any text-to-speech service compatible with OpenAI /v1/audio/speech. Used for reading answers aloud and for the voice assistant. Leave blank to use the built-in engine.
Looks at the screenshot and outputs a text description. Must support vision.
Engine used by the agent\'s web search and the built-in browser. \"Auto\" picks by IP: mainland China → Baidu, elsewhere → Google.

When on: the \"Q&A vision model\" first describes the image you send in Q&A, then the \"Q&A model\" above answers from that description — so a text-only Q&A model can still \"see\" images. Independent from the agent\'s pairing.
Describes the image you send in Q&A and outputs text. Must support vision.
The model used in Q&A mode; can differ from the agent model. Pick any model you like.
No models available. Add a service in Manage providers and run Discover models first.
The maximum number of action steps the agent runs per task; it stops automatically at the limit. With \"Unlimited steps\" on, it keeps going until the task finishes — use with care.
Off by default. When on, actions like payment, transfer and delete are no longer double-confirmed — use with caution.
When on, the agent first drafts an overall plan and waits for your approval; nothing runs until you tap \"Start\".

Q&A remembers preferences and facts you share, and can search your past conversations to answer \"what we discussed last time\" (all on-device only). You can also tell the AI to \"remember…\" or \"forget…\". Incognito Q&A never uses memory or history recall.
This deletes everything Q&A has remembered and cannot be undone.

This Privacy Policy ("this Policy") describes how ConeAI ("the App") handles your personal information. By downloading, installing, or using the App, you are deemed to have read and agreed to this Policy. If you disagree, stop using and uninstall immediately.

1. Information We Collect
1.1 Information you actively configure: Provider name, Base URL, API key, and model list that you enter in "Provider Management". API keys are stored encrypted on your device using Android system-level EncryptedSharedPreferences and are never saved or transmitted to us in plaintext.
1.2 Information generated during use:
 (1) Conversation history, task logs, plans, and reasoning for Agent and Q&A;
 (2) Images, files, and screenshots you actively upload;
 (3) Screen captures and OCR results when the Agent executes tasks;
 (4) Voice input to the voice assistant (processed after being converted to text by system/offline speech recognition).
This information is stored by default in your device's local app database or file directory. We do not actively collect or upload it to our servers.
1.3 Device and permission information: The App does not actively collect device identifiers, location, contacts, or gallery. It only temporarily accesses relevant data after you grant the corresponding system permission, for the stated function.

2. How We Use Information
2.1 We use the above information only to provide the App's features: executing your automation tasks, answering questions, recording conversation history, displaying task status, and generating answers and plans.
2.2 We will not use your information to push ads, sell it to any third party, or use it for purposes not stated in this Policy.

3. Information Storage and Transmission
3.1 Local storage: Except for API keys you configure, conversation history, task logs, and attachments are stored (unencrypted or app-level encrypted) in your device's local app data directory. Uninstalling the App clears all such local data.
3.2 Uploaded to third parties: To enable AI capabilities, the App sends your conversation text, images, screenshots, and files via HTTPS to the third-party model service you configured. This transmission occurs between your device and the third party; we do not pass through, store, or relay this data.
3.3 Third-party handling of your data (including retention, training, compliance review) is governed by that third party's own privacy policy; we cannot and will not be responsible for it. We recommend reading the relevant third party's privacy policy before use.

4. Incognito Q&A Mode
4.1 The App provides an "Incognito Q&A" toggle in Q&A mode. When enabled:
 (1) Q&A content is kept in memory only and is not written to the local database;
 (2) Image attachments you send are stored in the app cache directory and automatically deleted when you switch or disable incognito mode;
 (3) Closing incognito mode or exiting the App clears the relevant temporary content.
4.2 Note: Incognito mode only reduces local retention and does not change the data transmission relationship between you and the third-party model service. Whether the third party retains your request content is governed by its privacy policy.

5. System Permissions
The App requests the following system permissions, each for its stated purpose. You may revoke any at any time in system settings:
5.1 Accessibility Service: reads screen structure and performs click, input, and swipe actions on your behalf. Used only during the App's runtime; screen content is not uploaded.
5.2 Screen Capture (MediaProjection): captures screen images for AI visual understanding. Screenshots are sent only to the third-party model service you configured and are not actively uploaded to us.
5.3 Overlay: displays a draggable floating control center for pause or takeover.
5.4 Microphone: voice recognition for the voice assistant. May use online or offline recognition; offline recognition is fully on-device.
5.5 Query All Packages: enables the Agent to accurately open the app you specify.
5.6 Notifications: displays status notifications while foreground services run.
5.7 Call State and Dialing (if applicable): detects incoming calls to pause tasks and avoid misoperation.

6. Information Security
6.1 We use Android system-level encryption to protect your API keys and HTTPS for data transmission between you and third-party model services.
6.2 Please understand that no absolutely secure data transmission or storage exists on the internet. If your device is rooted, intruded upon, lost, or you actively send sensitive information to a third-party model service, leakage may occur, for which we are not liable.
6.3 Upon learning of a security incident, we will take reasonable measures and fulfill notification obligations as required by law.

7. Your Rights
7.1 You may clear conversation history, delete attachments, delete Provider configurations, or uninstall the App at any time to clear all local data.
7.2 You may revoke any permission granted to the App in system settings at any time.
7.3 Since your data is primarily stored locally and we do not actively collect it, you generally do not need to exercise data rights through us; if necessary, contact us via in-app channels.

8. Minors
8.1 The App is not intended for children under 13. If you are a minor, use the App under the supervision of a guardian who has read and agreed to this Policy, and you are responsible for your use.
8.2 Guardians should safeguard the device and unlock method to prevent minors from misusing the App for high-risk operations. We are not liable for consequences of minors' use.

9. Third-Party Links and Services
9.1 The built-in browser, remote control, and other features may involve third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for their content, privacy practices, or security.
9.2 When accessing third parties via the App, also comply with their terms and privacy policies.

10. Cookies and Similar Technologies
The App itself does not use cookies. Third-party model services or third-party websites you visit via the built-in browser may use cookies or similar technologies, governed by their own policies.

11. Updates to This Policy
11.1 We may update this Policy from time to time. Updates take effect upon publication in the App.
11.2 If you disagree, stop using and uninstall. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.

12. Dispute Resolution and Governing Law
This Policy is governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China (excluding Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan). Disputes are first settled by negotiation; failing that, brought to the competent people's court at our location.

13. Contact
For matters under this Policy, contact us via the in-app "Permissions & Environment" page or published developer channels.

—— End of Policy ——
